intro.en: Custom panel-mount and bulkhead cable assemblies turn a cable end into a defined equipment interface, with the connector, cutout, hardware, seal, cable construction and validation engineered together.
intro.zh: 定制面板安装与隔板电缆组件，将线端变成边界清晰的设备接口，并将连接器、开孔、五金、密封、线缆结构与验证协同开发。

knowledge.en: Panel mounting describes installation, not signal capability, ingress protection or an interchangeable connector family.
knowledge.zh: 面板安装描述安装方式，并不自动代表信号能力、防护等级或通用接口。

notes.en: Provide the exact interface, panel material and thickness, cutout drawing, mounting side, hardware, route, environment and test requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供准确接口、面板材料与厚度、开孔图、安装方向、紧固件、路径、环境及测试要求。

delivery.en: Approve mechanical fit, interface sample, sealing stack, circuit map and project-specific test evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认机械配合、接口样件、密封叠层、回路图及项目特定测试证据。

faq.zh: 面板安装电缆常见问题

subtitle.en: Design the equipment boundary, not only the cable ends
subtitle.zh: 设计设备边界，不只是线缆两端

lead.en: Coordinate both sides of the panel as one interface.
lead.zh: 将面板两侧作为一个接口协同定义。
